title: Paris
completionText: You leave Paris carrying philosophes' letters and a dangerous taste for politics. The Channel awaits.

cards.dialogue: "The Faubourg Saint-Germain wakes early. Carriages clatter, hawkers cry, and a small boy offers to carry your bags for a sou. The city smells of bread and Enlightenment."
cards.leftText: A solid Norman shoulders your trunk. He recommends a café where Diderot dines on Tuesdays.
cards.rightText: The boy proves swift and honest. He also tells you which streets to avoid after dark.
